part.text:
The robot reached the green panel at the end of the corridor and is now resting (crouched, motors off).

It took a winding route: straight down the corridor, then a left turn, then a few short steps toward the panel. The final camera view shows the panel directly ahead and close, but I had no distance sensor reading for it, so the exact gap is an estimate.
